title: Value-destruction / stranded-resource kill sweep
purpose: Search lower-permission Xuzhou/Jiangsu flows where usable assets, materials or products visibly lose value through bundling, downgrade, discard, idle inventory, project completion or acceptance mismatch, then test whether incumbents already provide liquidation/reuse/secondary-market routing.
scan_rule: USABLE SURPLUS != STRANDED RESOURCE when a mature secondary market already exists
A price discount or downgrade is not evidence that a new control plane can retain margin after incumbent channels.

observed_loss: Xuzhou property listings show repeated relisting, price reductions and explicit whole-lot/no-split terms for heterogeneous idle assets.
Low-value lots can face transaction fees, deposits, viewing, removal and logistics burden.
counterevidence: The transaction platform can support both whole-lot and split auction modes, so no software incapability is proven.
Single standalone equipment can also relist repeatedly, so relisting cannot be attributed solely to bundle granularity.
National industrial-asset marketplaces already provide auctions, large buyer pools, matching, inspection/viewing and logistics coordination.

patterns_tested.pattern: generic stagnant inventory / industrial tail stock
patterns_tested.observed_loss: Enterprises hold dead stock, idle material and surplus inventory.
counterevidence: Mature disposal and inventory marketplaces already aggregate large enterprise seller and buyer pools.
Dedicated tail-stock platforms support publication, matching, auctions and direct purchase.

patterns_tested.observed_loss: Used industrial containers can otherwise become disposal cost.
counterevidence: IBC manufacturers and specialist providers already offer collection, cleaning, reconditioning, leak testing and reuse.
Local Xuzhou recycling listings show active collection of IBCs, drums, pallets and returnable packaging.

patterns_tested.pattern: project-completion surplus cables / valves / electrical materials
observed_loss: Project completion naturally leaves usable cables, cabinets, controls and other spare materials.
Private listings show unused project-surplus cable offered directly for resale.
counterevidence: Specialist buyers already collect both new-unused and old project electrical materials, including small lots.
Industrial platforms already expose redundant inventory / inventory-material categories.
Asset platforms support resale of idle valves and electrical materials.

observed_loss: Xuzhou-area peach growers previously faced concentrated-market low prices and large loss.
counterevidence: Peach cold-chain/pre-cooling/storage capacity now directly reduces concentration loss.
Pizhou garlic already has large cold storage, processing firms, deep-processing products, export channels and lower-grade processing demand.

patterns_tested.observed_loss: Material can lose value because it is secondary grade, nonstandard, stale or not suited to the original customer's acceptance requirement.
counterevidence: 1Plas directly trades secondary-grade and stagnant plastic raw materials by grade, quantity, price and discount.
Steel producers already sell non-primary/secondary output through dedicated electronic auction channels.
Raw-material trading platforms already connect producers, distributors and downstream users via matching, bidding and spot transactions.

material_learning: Repeated value loss can coexist with a mature liquidation/reuse/secondary-market route.
Discounting, relisting or downgrade alone does not prove an open orchestration layer.
Generic stranded-asset, tail-stock, project-surplus, returnable-packaging and off-grade-material markets are already heavily routed.
Public low-value asset friction is real but currently high-permission and structurally close to asset-dealer/liquidator work rather than a low-capital Rooter control plane.
scan_conclusion.current_best_next_truth: Fresh Scan 011 should search only for post-secondary-market residuals: transactions where seller and buyer already exist and a liquidation/reuse marketplace also exists, but exchange still fails because acceptance evidence, condition grading, specification translation, permission, trust or settlement cannot be cheaply standardized. Do not continue generic waste/surplus/idle-inventory scanning.
